login.title: Sign in
login.description: Administration access to the dashboard of Meeko's documentation.
login.lead: Administration of Meeko's documentation: sources, translations, snapshots, moderation and metrics.
login.lifetime: The session lasts {ttl} and closes after {idle} without activity.

errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The user name or the password is not correct.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
errors.LOGIN_NOT_CONFIGURED: This server has no administrator account. Set ADMIN_USERNAME and ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH in apps/dashboard/.env and restart it.
errors.INVALID_ORIGIN: The server refused the submission because of its origin. Open the dashboard from its usual address.
errors.generic: Could not sign in. Try again; if it keeps failing, check the server console.
